# Every five-loop bare kernel and first-current spinor

These are complete geometric kernels at the recorded source assignments. All 200 topologies and all original edges are present. Each row gives the two coefficients multiplying the indicated original source spinors; the free lower index $+\dot a$ is retained. The source assignments are fixed inputs, not an assertion of arbitrary-source interpolation. Wick factors, couplings and endpoint displacement signs are not included.

[Complete exact coefficient archive](certificate.json).
